suread: review R1 素读（只读 text/，未开 md）

facts.fact: 从养大棚那次越轨之后，她在农场独处不超过二十分钟
facts.anchor: I spent no more than twenty minutes alone at the farm

facts.fact: Nova 探头进她那间霉味屋子，问了一堆关于文件的问题：进度、何时完成、税表有没有被弄脏
facts.anchor: whether a tax return was stained

facts.fact: Harrison 在她下午中段吃点心时出现在休息室，别扭地闲聊，主要聊那道越长越大、屋顶工也治不了的天花板裂缝
facts.anchor: making stilted small talk, mostly about the growing, roofer-resistant ceiling leak

facts.fact: 她推测是 Gazzie 吩咐两人看着她（apparently），可 Gazzie 一次也没来过
facts.anchor: Gazzie had apparently ordered them to babysit me, though she didn’t check on me once

facts.fact: 除了周五傍晚那段沉默的回程车程，他当天再没出现
facts.anchor: Beyond our silent drive back to Greer House Friday evening, I didn’t see her

facts.fact: 当晚她在梦里进进出出，浮现在月光下的沼泽岸边
facts.anchor: surfacing on a marsh shore in the moonlight

facts.fact: 水中两只黄色的眼睛朝她滑来
facts.anchor: two yellow eyes glided toward me

facts.fact: 一只纤细冰冷的手按在她背心正中推她向前，她踏进水里一步、又一步
facts.anchor: A delicate, cold hand pressed into the center of my back, pushing me forward, and I took one step into the water. Another.

facts.fact: 一条大得不可能的鳄鱼抬起头，水顺着吻部成股流下，它张开颌露出参差的黄牙
facts.anchor: An impossibly large alligator raised its head. Water ran down its snout in rivulets as it opened its jaws, revealing jagged yellowed teeth.

facts.fact: 震耳的嘶声扑来、越来越响，她双手捂住耳朵
facts.anchor: A deafening hiss whooshed toward me, growing louder and louder. I slammed my hands over my ears.

facts.fact: 她双眼猛地睁开
facts.anchor: My eyes flew open.

facts.fact: 肾上腺素流遍全身，她屏住呼吸直到确信嘶声已随梦一起消失
facts.anchor: I held my breath until I was sure the hiss had disappeared with the dream

facts.fact: 窗边漏进来的光太弱，她分不清那是日光还是月光
facts.anchor: The light drifting in from the window was so weak I wasn’t sure whether it came from the sun or moon.

facts.fact: 黑暗里她只勉强认出书桌与五斗橱；没什么异常在暗处等她
facts.anchor: Nothing out of the ordinary lay in wait for me.

facts.fact: 呻吟着坐起揉眼；这场梦呼应了 Ida 猎 Ironheart 的传说；如今她梦里和上班时都得面对鳄鱼
facts.anchor: The dream had echoed Ida’s legendary hunt for Ironheart.

facts.fact: 楼梯上一记脚步吱响，墙面随电流嗡鸣
facts.anchor: Then a step on the stair creaked, and the walls hummed with electricity.

facts.fact: 有什么拉了她一下，把她从被子里带出去
facts.anchor: Something pulled at me, drawing me out from under my covers.

facts.fact: 她以为是又早起的 Gazzie，也许能再听一个家族故事、对方也就重新喜欢她
facts.anchor: I assumed it was Gazzie, up early again. Maybe I’d get her to tell me another family story, and she’d like me again.

facts.fact: 她梦游般滑下床走到走廊，但起身太急；楼梯扶手在眼前褪淡，手指触到冰冷光滑的木
facts.anchor: Dreamily, I slid out of bed and wandered into the hallway, but I’d stood too quickly.

facts.fact: 接着是气味：茉莉，略微不对劲；是浓缩香水而非鲜花的那种淡香
facts.anchor: The smell came next: jasmine, slightly off. A concentrated perfume rather than the light scent of fresh flowers.

facts.fact: 楼下的动静引开她：一个人的轮廓——与其说有形不如说一层薄纱般的黑色模糊——从楼梯底滑进餐室、消失
facts.anchor: more a gauzy, black blur than anything—glided from the bottom of the stairs into the dining room, out of sight

facts.fact: 只剩一条长而沉的裙摆最轻微的一声窸窣
facts.anchor: All that remained was the faintest swish of a long, heavy skirt.

facts.fact: 她本能地知道有东西不对劲：那影子既不是 Gazzie 也不是 Virginia 姨妈
facts.anchor: I knew, instinctually, that something was wrong, that this figure wasn’t Gazzie or Aunt Virginia.

facts.fact: 她的第一个解释是有人闯进屋
facts.anchor: Someone must have broken into the house.

facts.fact: 她死攥扶手、手忽然出汗，喊救救命
facts.anchor: Clinging to the banister, hands suddenly slick with sweat, I screamed for help.

facts.fact: Virginia 应声「Dart?」从餐室冲进门厅，前后不到十五秒
facts.anchor: rushing from the dining room into the entryway no more than fifteen seconds later

facts.fact: 前门透进的微光里她已能判断是清晨；Virginia 的白发发亮，她几乎瘫软在地
facts.anchor: I nearly crumpled to the floor with relief.

facts.fact: 一个她从未见过的女人出现在她身后，越过她的肩张望
facts.anchor: A woman I’d never met appeared behind her, peering over her shoulder.

facts.fact: Virginia 回头介绍：这是 Lena；见她一脸茫然又补一句「她是开保洁公司的？」
facts.anchor: “She owns the cleaning service?”

facts.fact: 她尴尬地答「对」，自问刚才看到的是不是她——不是，那人穿大红 polo，再暗也该注意到
facts.anchor: Had she been the woman I’d seen? No. She was wearing a bright red polo shirt; I would have noticed that, even in the dim light.

facts.fact: 她忙问你们团队还有别的人在吗
facts.anchor: Is someone else from your team here? I thought I saw someone.

facts.fact: 两个女人都摇头；Virginia 低声把 Lena 遣开，再转回来时目光落在她身后某处
facts.anchor: Aunt Virginia quietly turned to Lena and excused her. Then she turned my way again, eyes settling on something behind me.

facts.fact: 她猛转身、双手抬起挡开逼近的东西
facts.anchor: I whirled around, hands raised to fend off whatever approached.

facts.fact: 来人是 Harrison：头发微乱、脸颊发红、光着上身
facts.anchor: It was Harrison, his hair slightly tousled, cheeks pink. Shirtless.

facts.fact: 她不由自主注意到他宽肩、一线金色体毛顺着肚子垂进一条印满松鼠的睡裤
facts.anchor: the line of golden hair trailing down his stomach and into a pair of long pajama bottoms dotted with squirrels

facts.fact: 他的皮肤光滑古铜，像冲浪板广告模特
facts.anchor: His skin was smooth and bronze, like a surfboard model’s.

facts.fact: 她移开视线、双臂交叉抱在 T 恤前，骂自己没顺手套件内衣
facts.anchor: cursing myself for not throwing on a bra

facts.fact: 「我有时住那间空房」他语气随意，却设法显得有点得意；「深夜回来的时候」
facts.anchor: “I stay in the spare room sometimes,” he said casually, managing to look slightly triumphant.

facts.fact: 「深夜在干什么？」她呛回去；她的恐惧似乎把火气烧得更旺
facts.anchor: My fear seemed to stoke my annoyance.

facts.fact: 「查账」「复盘季度目标」「Gazzie 总会不由分说灌我些威士忌——你懂她的」；顿了顿：「其实我猜你不懂」
facts.anchor: “Actually, I guess you don’t.”

facts.fact: 心往下沉，她想起几天前那个男人的声音；当然，Harrison 八成常年住在 Greer House
facts.anchor: Heart sinking, I remembered the man’s voice from a few nights before. Of course. Harrison probably stayed in Greer House all the time.

facts.fact: 他与 Gazzie 的关系远不止雇佣，几乎是家人；一句独立成段：替代孙子
facts.anchor: A surrogate grandson.

facts.fact: 她独自陪母亲这些年，这男人一路钻进了祖母的心；难怪她想让他继承
facts.anchor: this man had been worming his way into my grandmother’s heart. No wonder she wanted him to inherit.

facts.fact: Virginia 从楼下问：你确定刚才看见的不是 Lena？
facts.anchor: “You’re sure you didn’t just see Lena?”

facts.fact: 她咽下疼痛的刺，回到眼前的问题：不是；那人穿深色，也许是条长裙
facts.anchor: Swallowing the sting of pain, I refocused on the problem at hand.

facts.fact: 「会不会是场噩梦？」她摇头
facts.anchor: “Could it have been a bad dream?”

facts.fact: 她摇头——否掉「会不会是场噩梦」这个解释
facts.anchor: I shook my head.

facts.fact: 鸡皮疙瘩满臂、揉也压不住；嗡鸣已经安静下来
facts.anchor: Goosebumps covered my arms, refusing to subside as I rubbed them. The hum had quieted.

facts.fact: 尽管 Virginia 的解释完全合理，她只在那嗡声之后遇到怪事
facts.anchor: Despite Aunt Virginia’s perfectly reasonable explanation, I only ever heard it before something odd happened.

facts.fact: 她本想接受别的解释，但这是她在 Greer House 第二次见到无法解释的人——比浴水里变形的倒影难打发得多
facts.anchor: this was the second time I’d seen an inexplicable person in Greer House, and it was more difficult to explain away than a distorted reflection in bathwater.

facts.fact: 「胡说」Gazzie 的声音从 Harrison 与她身后传来；随后是人本人，头发用惯常的银色抓夹拢起
facts.anchor: “Bull,” came Gazzie’s voice from behind Harrison and me, shortly followed by the woman herself, hair pulled back with its usual silver claw.

facts.fact: Virginia 瞪她：你给我闭嘴
facts.anchor: Aunt Virginia glared at her. “You be quiet.”

facts.fact: 显然起早的 Gazzie 已穿戴整齐（而不是来看她）；若无其事、甚至轻快地绕开两人，轻盈下楼踱到前门，懒得解释
facts.anchor: Gazzie, apparently an early riser, had finished dressing for the day instead of checking on me.

facts.fact: 她走后 Harrison 回客房，路上给她一个气人的从容耸肩；Virginia 拍响双手：索性早点出发
facts.anchor: giving me an infuriatingly calm shrug on the way—Aunt Virginia clapped her hands.

facts.fact: 「好」她脑子飞转，需要先稳住自己：她在幻想、在出现幻觉——也许是卧室铅漆吸多了，或档案室的毒霉
facts.anchor: Maybe I’d accidentally inhaled lead paint in my bedroom? Or toxic mold in the file room?

facts.fact: Virginia 提议骑车去海边；语气近乎绝望，但 Dart 感激那份强撑的愉快
facts.anchor: Aunt Virginia’s tone edged on desperate, but I appreciated the attempt at cheerfulness.

facts.fact: 她飞快答应，急于离开 Greer House 和潜伏在其中的一切古怪
facts.anchor: I agreed quickly, eager to leave Greer House and whatever peculiarities lurked within.
